programme.title: The Observers
programme.desc: The Observers on France 24 is a weekly show produced with photos, videos and personal accounts from Observers around the world. Top international current affairs are covered by using eyewitness accounts from Observers- people who are at the heart of an event. They send their photos and videos, which are verified and contextualized by France 24 team of professional journalists in Paris. The Observers are volunteers, and are not paid for their contributions.

programme.title: Drama Serial 'The Scent Of The Wind' Week 15
programme.desc: The 114th drama serial follows two women, Rin (Mikami Ai) and Naomi (Kosaka Juri), who paved the way for nursing in the Meiji era. Each carries her own struggles, yet together they support one another as they race to protect the wounded and vulnerable, often standing up against powerful forces. Through conflicts and hardships, the two gradually grow. No matter which way the wind blows, this unconventional duo continues their journey in search of happiness.

Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. programme.title: The Other Side Of Gentleman
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo...

However, when another member of the Squad begins killing every major drug market, Li has to don the identity of Black Mask once again...

programme.desc: It's a birthday bonanza at the garage! First, the Mechs throw a surprise party for Kat. Then, for Gecko's birthday, Yellow gets carried away by balloons! Celebrate with Baby Truck, Green Mechanical, and Miles the Motorcycle.

programme.title: E8 - JJ's Birthday Adventure
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday adventures! He has a balloon boat race, a surprise party on the bus, and plays follow-the-leader with Dad. Go on a magical train ride and help find the missing birthday dog, Bingo!

programme.title: E5 - A Fabulous Birthday Fiesta!
programme.desc: Celebrate Nina's birthday with a fun-filled piÃ±ata party! Join her as she plays with her family, goes on a rainbow flower scavenger hunt, makes breakfast with Abuelita, and helps her dog, Patas, at the pet store.

programme.title: E4 - Baby John's Family Are His Heroes!
programme.desc: Baby John thinks his family members are the best heroes! He really loves & admires his dad, & wants to copy everything he does to be just like him. His big brother Jack is a hero, too, & is always willing to help his little brother & teach him new things. After Mom's cupcakes go missing, Baby John dresses up as a police officer to find out who took them, interviewing each of his family member heroes!

programme.title: E2 - Healthy Habits & Happy You!
programme.desc: It's time to learn some healthy habits to keep you happy! First, Grandma Mei makes sure everyone washes their hands with lots of bubbles before eating some yummy dumplings. Then, when Baby Izzy doesn't want to eat her vegetables, Mei uses a bit of magic to make the veggies come to life to sing & dance! The healthy habits continue as the friends learn how to recycle trash to help save the planet & Ella learns to get right back up after getting a boo boo.

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E5 -It's Bath Time!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers explore how bathtime is fun and teach kids the importance of getting clean. We discover the importance of bathtime through bubble play, modeling healthy hygiene habits, and a good night's sleep!

The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' & an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat & her kitten.

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 特務機構雪衣衛首領風作人奉嘉帝之命，潛入定遠侯府尋找前朝太子，意圖斬草除根。然而在這個過程中，鳳作人卻發現嘉帝的背後有人正在佈置更大的陰謀。

programme.title: E31
programme.desc: 故事講述了周筱風（趙又廷 飾）、方筱然（毛曉彤 飾）和林逸（金世佳 飾）三位心臟科醫生機緣巧合下，在東立醫院心臟中心相遇。三人因專業背景、職業理念不同而產生摩擦碰撞，隨後在治病救人的過程中逐漸磨合達成默契，最終在生命戰場並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E29
programme.desc: 年輕狀元郎陸江來上任淳寧縣令後屢破奇案，卻因捲入一樁殺妻舊案，從官場新星淪落至絕境。瀕死之際，幸得茶王之女榮善寶搭救。兩人聯手整頓家族、開拓茶道，在茶園裡締結了一段愛情佳話。

programme.title: E16
programme.desc: 高冷孤僻的企業繼承人顧榮儼然是個“傲嬌公子”，而看似軟萌文靜的少女蘇靜靜實則武藝不凡。一場意外讓“元氣少女”蘇靜靜與“不食人間煙火”的顧榮產生交集，還成為他的貼身保鏢。性格、習慣大相徑庭的兩人不得不開啟室友生活，在追求人生目標中攜手蛻變與成長……

programme.title: E11 - German-Pratin Style/Hotel Victoria Nice
programme.desc: Decorators and gallery owners meet in Saint-Germain-des-Pres to shake up the German-Pratin style. Find out all about the origins of the Tarte Tropezienne. The great tradition of Nice resorts opens a new chapter in its history with the Hotel Victoria. Faux fur is now an integral part of the leather goods at some of the world's leading fashion houses.

programme.title: E8 - Liege Sart Tilman
programme.desc: A finale towards the ''fiery city''! At its highest point is the University of Liege - Sart Tilman campus, surrounded by nature. The site includes an open-air museum, the Streupas heath, Colonster Castle and the Robert Louis-Dreyfus Football Academy.

programme.title: E10 - Collectors
programme.desc: Collectors' passion grows over the years, sometimes turning into obsession. In these very closed circles, members know each other and interact. Most are discreet, often reluctant to reveal their treasures. Others agree to share them...

programme.title: E2 - The Coastal Enthusiasts: From The Arcachon Basin To The North Of Brittany
programme.desc: Along the Atlantic coast to the English Channel stretches a rich but fragile coastline. From the Vendee marshes to the Arcachon basin, passing through the bay of Saint-Malo and the fort of Fouras in Charente-Maritime, local actors are intensely involved in preserving nature and heritage.

programme.title: E5 - Eyes In The Skies
programme.desc: An amateur astronomer, Michel Ory has a passion: hunting asteroids and comets. He is the only living Swiss citizen to have discovered two comets, and is credited with the discovery of hundreds of asteroids. A luminous quest that takes us from Switzerland to Morocco.

E4 - Beast Buddies
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

programme.title: E6 - Ozzy, Riri, and Gaia
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: E2 - Life's Lessons
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: E3 - Life's Legacies
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: E1 - The Little Penguin
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: E2 - Secret Life of the Emu
programme.desc: The Emu is Australia’s biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.title: E3 - Aerial Hunters
programme.desc: Australia’s birds of prey are some of the region's fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australia’s aerial hunters.

programme.title: E3 - Lake Hunters
programme.desc: Sri Lanka’s lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but don’t be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

programme.title: E4 - Web of Life
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: E6 - Life on the Wing
programme.desc: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

He later attempted to commit suicide but was unsuccessful, and was eventually sentenced to rehabilitate in a psychiatric facility indefinitely. Dr. CHOW (HUANG Xiao Ming) is FAN's psychiatrist. He believes FAN is cured after 3-year treatment and is alone in opposition to all doctors' objections to discharge FAN. programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: Pierce
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.

programme.title: Fragments of the Last Will
programme.desc: In 1945, after the end of World War II, Hatao Yamamoto was imprisoned in a concentration camp in Sibera, Russia. Despite the harsh, despairing condition in the camp, Hatao Yamamoto kept telling other prisoners not to give up hope, and that the day when they could all go back home would come. Hatao Yamamoto firmly believed that he would return to Japan and meet his wife, Mojimi Yamamoto, and their children someday. 8 years after the war, he received a postcard from his wife with a one-line message written on it, stating that “We are waiting for you to come back”. Meanwhile, Hatao Yamamoto's health was deteriorating rapidly. After having a diagnosis, the doctor told him that he had only three months left... After listening to his friends' advices, he decided to write a will and left it to his friends to bring it to his family when they were released. However, the will was seen as a spying message by the officers in the concentration camp and was confiscated...

programme.title: The Way We Talk
programme.desc: Wolf, born into a Deaf family, embraces sign language with confidence despite obstacles in life; Sophie, having a cochlear implant at a young age, continuously strives to be seen as 'normal', despite struggling with oral language. Alan, with a cochlear implant like Sophie, is capable of both oral and sign language; he advocates for diverse modes of communication within the deaf community. Bound by love and friendship, the three embark on a self-discovering journey with their own moments of pain.

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。
